claims: PWCE retains immutable capability snapshots under exact authority, principal, sites, Assistant, endpoint, participants, audience, World and execution-environment scope. Repeated current reads retain the original reference and issuance time.

Explicit unknown, foreign, expired or invalidated snapshot references fail without substitution. Calls omitting a reference pin a current server-selected snapshot; that pin does not prove prior client review.

Every Gateway effect requires catalog membership/version and current snapshot binding at admission and dispatch. Provider catalog/target/configuration changes and World changes invalidate observed prior references permanently; restoring old content cannot revive them.

The original snapshot bytes, captured scope, source digest and SHA-256 commit with an admitted action. Corrupt or missing retained evidence cannot support a later result. Snapshot-bound dispatch requires a trusted live guard, not just a stored reference.

A duplicate Gateway command reads its recorded disposition and cannot restart an action interrupted after admission. The authenticated HTTP action test exercises explicit snapshot selection, unknown-reference refusal and one total synthetic dispatch.

compatibility.note: No published schema, catalog, generated-client or bundle artifact changed. Snapshot selection uses the existing open V1 operation payload; legacy omitted-reference requests acquire a server-held snapshot. The existing sourceRevision/invalidationSequence retain their grant-revision meaning; full catalog/scope binding uses the unique retained reference and preserved source/content digests.

limits: Process-local registry follows process-local Gateway authority; restart requires fresh authority and discovery. Default 256 retained entries, configurable 1-1024, with 16 KiB source catalogs and 32 KiB retained evidence. Unexpired entries are not evicted to hide capacity exhaustion.
The producer retains the existing single-writer JSON StateStore guarantee. Persistent catalog reconstruction and physical target-state preconditions are not established.
